title: The exact Sobolev endpoint for Schrödinger convergence

result.label: The exact Sobolev endpoint for Schrödinger convergence
result.statement: Proves almost-everywhere convergence e^ it f f as t 0 for every f H^ n/(2(n+1)) ( R^n) and every dimension n ≥ 2. This attains the sharp Sobolev equality case of Carleson's Schrödinger convergence problem, including the planar endpoint H 1/3 .
